description: Activate a deactivated knowledge base so it appears in search results.
embedding_description: Re-enable a previously deactivated knowledge base so its chunks are included in search results again. Flips the install record's active flag back on, and does not re-index or re-embed any content. Use to restore a knowledge base you had temporarily turned off back into the searchable set.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: KB is now active and included in search
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use list_installed to verify the KB name.
